name: 32951-specdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine (UniProcExecutor).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 32 requests / 1800 s safety, with a 10% warmup and 10% cooldown discard.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix bucket. Prompt exactly 80 tokens and output exactly 1024 tokens with ignore_eos, both fixed so every request executes the same number of decode steps.
purpose: A single-user long-form writing assistant generating 1024-token replies from short prompts with an 8B model on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM engine for 32951-specdecode-8b-1gpu, commit ffb5b32b5f2a37ea58261747aef9e5f3907b9941.
# Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml, which is per-machine.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tokenizer: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
dtype: auto

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE AS INLINE JSON: an indented block mapping here parses as an empty value
# and the key is dropped whole, so the engine starts with no drafter, at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 1}

async-scheduling: true
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Covers the workload's longest request (80 prompt + 1024 output) and is also the draft
# checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings, so no request can outrun either model.
max-model-len: 2048

disable-cascade-attn: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
